items.title: Ellis Marsalis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 7, 2020
items.q: when the talking heads, when Carson came on NBC... he was pretty straight up and down.

ctx.x: He had the gift of gab didn’t he?

He did, but not just the gift of gab, see Cannon had a way of expressing things which was always near some aspect of humor, which is what people would relate to. I mean if you think about later, you know, when the talking heads, when Carson came on NBC, after — I can’t think of his name, but anyway he was pretty straight up and down.
